{{status

| type                   = Counter
| description            = You gain more Attack Damage. You lose 10 Rage every second if you have not been Hit or gained Rage in the past 2 seconds.
}}

{{about|the game mechanic|the support gem|Rage Support}}

'''Rage''' is a counter utilized by certain attack skills and [[Ascendancy class]]es. Characters with Rage deal more [[attack damage]] — this affects the [[hit]] damage with attacks, but not [[ailment]]s from the attack such as {{stl|Bleeding}}. This increases in magnitude with the amount of Rage accumulated. Rage rapidly depletes if you haven't gained Rage or taken a hit for 2 seconds.

==Mechanics==
The maximum Rage a character can have by default is 30, but can be increased by items and passives. A character loses 10 Rage every second after not having gained Rage or been hit in the past 2 seconds. {{c|mod|Inherent Rage loss is #% slower/faster}} modifiers affect the amount of Rage lost per second. Sources which grant Rage over time such as {{psl|Chainbreaker}} and {{il|Kaom's Spirit}} do not reset the timer for inherent Rage loss.

Characters gain the following effects for each point of Rage:
* 1% more Attack Damage

Effects which state "Every Rage also grants", such as {{il|Kaom's Primacy}} and {{psl|Crave the Slaughter}}, will scale with Rage effect.

Rage is ''not'' classified as a [[buff]], therefore increased buff effects will not apply to the effects of having Rage.<ref name="Rage is not a buff" />

All sources of Rage gain on hit are combined into one source. There is a shared cooldown preventing you from generating Rage on Hit from more than one hit every 0.5 seconds.

[[Minion]]s cannot gain Rage.

'''Minimum Rage''': Sources of minimum rage, such as {{psl|Always Angry}}, will cause hitting the minimum value as "running out of rage" when draining rage such as through {{il|Berserk}} or {{il|Rage Vortex of Berserking}}.

The following [[Historic]] jewel [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to rage:

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Rage has been made more fundamental and discoverable. Rage now grants 1% more Attack Damage per Rage gained, to a maximum of 30, but no longer inherently grants Attack Speed or Movement Speed. You lose 10 Rage every 1 second if you have not been Hit or gained Rage in the last 2 seconds (previously 1 Rage every 0.5 seconds).
* Many sources of Rage now generate Rage much more quickly. There is now a shared cooldown preventing you from generating Rage on Hit from more than one hit every 0.5 seconds.
* A number of Rage-related stats have had their wording updated to make it more clear that they scale with increased rage effect.
* Rage effect applies to the damage inherently granted by Rage, and other bonuses granted per X Rage if you have any. Bonuses while you have a certain amount of Rage, or other effects that refer to your Rage but do not cause Rage to grant additional stats, are not affected.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0c|
* Fixed a bug where the amount of '''Rage''' a [[Berserker]] could have could become invalid.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* We wanted to add support for mechanics that have been added in the past few years that as of yet do not have adequate support on the [[Passive Skill|passive tree]]. Some of these mechanics include Rage, [[Unleash]], [[Corpse|Corpse manipulation]], [[Warcry|Warcries]], [[Heralds]] and [[Aura#Banners|Banners]].
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* Now no longer causes your character to lose life (previously, you lost .1% of life per second per rage, so 5% of life per second at maximum rage).
* Rage is now displayed along the top-left of the Mana orb, so you can see exactly how much Rage you have at any given time.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.2.0|
* Added to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
